CONFIDENTIAL.
June 23,                                                                                              3.

My dear Barton,

The attached translation of an
article in the "New Shanghai Life", a local
Russian organ, of June 10, 1923 on "The Labour
Movement in South China" is of considerable
interest. If the information contained therein
is true, it shows that there is considerable
organization and strength behind the movement.
The article is undoubtedly intended for
propaganda purposes and is almost certainly
written with the idea of impressing the writers'
Bolshevik friends in Russia.

Yours sincerely,

S. Barton, Esquire, C.M.G.,
H. B. M.'s Consul-General,
Shanghai.

"New Shanghai
Life"
10. 6. 23.

LABOUR MOVEMENT IN SOUTH CHINA.
Industrial districts: The seven Southern Provinces having a definite number of qualified workmen are the following: Kwangtung, Yunnan, Fukien and the so called "English" port Hongkong, seized by the English for opium burned there by Chinese and the Macao Port simply stolen by the Portuguese. The large labour centres in Kwangtung are Canton with a considerable number of towns surrounding it and then Hongkong and Macao.
As no statistics has been maintained in Canton up to the present time it is very difficult to estimate the number of workmen engaged in all work-shops, factories, mills and carpenter shops. The most prominent leaders of the labour movement have been studying the matter for a long time and have very little knowledge of the number of workmen; they estimate the number "approximately" from 300 to 400 thousand.
In Hongkong, according to the statement of labour unions there are about 200,000 labourers; and in Macao also "approximately" about 60,000 labourers.
Labour situation in Kwangtung: As regards the labour situation during the past three years it is necessary to note two periods very much different one from the other: the time when power was held by the Kwangse reactionaries and the time of Sun's and Chen's Governments. The first period may be described as the last days of the old and ancient build of brotherly unification between labourers and masters and the end of the former's search for their release from slavery. The second period was a time of the labourers' release from the chains of "brotherly" guilds and the formation, through the assistance of the intelligentsia, of their own purely labour organizations, this having been rendered easy mainly by the return of Republican rule
The labourers' situation at the time when the Kwangse reactionaries were in power was one of very great difficulty. Having no organization of their own except secret circles or clubs, which are unable, owing to strict police regulations, to assist the labourers much and which had to submit to extensive exploitation, whilst every attempt at protest was suppressed by the authorities at the outset. Complete depression and fear of the Kwangse reactionaries reigned amongst almost all ranks of the labour population, and even skilled workmen, though more conscious and of great use to the authorities, seldom dared to raise their voice.
Since the expulsion of the reactionaries from Canton by Sun and Chen, the labour masses for the first time after the Revolution began to breathe more freely and formed their own organizations and to start an open economic struggle with the masters. The change in the situation following upon the expulsion of the reactionaries was, however, so remarkable that the majority of the labour leaders at first became absolutely bewildered and used their energy to make the position of Sun's Government secure, considering it as their own Government, that is one destined to protect labour interests.
The "holiday" spirit resulting from their release from the yoke of the Kwangse reactionaries made a large number of workmen to forget their recent troubles and they fell a easy prey to bourgeois provocation which made clever use of this spirit. The labourers voluntarily caused

俄文报纸摘录译文。

《新上海
生活》
1923年6月10日。

华南劳工运动。
工业区：拥有确定数量的合格工人的南方七省如下：广东、云南、福建，以及所谓的“英国”港口香港（英国人因中国人在那里焚烧鸦片而夺取）和仅仅被葡萄牙人窃取的澳门港。广东的主要劳工中心是广州及其周围的大量城镇，其次是香港和澳门。
由于广州至今未保存统计数据，因此很难估计所有作坊、工厂、磨坊和木工店中雇佣的工人数量。劳工运动的最著名领袖们长期研究这一问题，但对工人数量知之甚少；他们“大约”估计人数在30万至40万之间。
在香港，根据工会的声明，约有20万名劳工；在澳门也“大约”有6万名劳工。
广东的劳工状况：关于过去三年的劳工状况，有必要指出两个截然不同的时期：广西反动派掌权的时期，以及孙和陈政府的时期。第一个时期可以描述为旧式的、古老的劳资兄弟般统一结构的末日，也是前者寻求从奴隶制中解放的终结。第二个时期则是劳工从“兄弟会”行会的枷锁中解放出来，并在知识分子的协助下建立自己纯粹的劳工组织的时期，这主要得益于共和统治的回归而变得容易。
当广西反动派掌权时，劳工的处境非常艰难。除了秘密圈子或俱乐部外，他们没有自己的组织，而这些组织由于严格的警察规定，无法给予劳工太多帮助，且不得不忍受广泛的剥削，同时任何抗议企图在一开始就被当局镇压。几乎所有阶层的劳动人口中都弥漫着彻底的压抑和对广西反动派的恐惧，即使是技术更熟练、对当局更有用的技工，也很少敢发声。
自从孙和陈将反动派逐出广州后，劳工大众在革命后第一次开始更自由地呼吸，组建了自己的组织，并开始与雇主进行公开的经济斗争。然而，驱逐反动派后局势的变化如此显著，以至于大多数劳工领袖起初完全感到困惑，并将精力用于巩固孙政府的地位，将其视为自己的政府，即注定要保护劳工利益的政府。
从广西反动派的桎梏中解放出来所产生的“节日”精神，使大量工人忘记了最近的苦难，他们成了资产阶级挑衅的轻易猎物，后者巧妙地利用了这种精神。劳工自愿让自己

page_data.en:
316.

themselves to be enslaved, refusing all increase of wages,
reducing the scale of wages in force and increasing the
working hours feeling quite certain that by so doing they
were helping to re-establish their province, which had
been pillaged by the Kwangse men. This state of affairs
continued for several months until the "holiday" spirit
lasted and then the workmen were forced to think seriously
over their economic position.
Growth of labour organizations: A change in the political
situation enabled the workmen to form their own organizations
and they started to establish unions with all their energy.
An initiative group of this or that profession convenes a
general meeting and proposes to form a united association
with its own premises, the members' fees being from 10 to
20 cents per month, with an elected committee (in the case
of barbers 50 men and printers 10 persons). The articles
of an association contain several paragraphs on the rights
of members of the union and in some articles even the aim
of the society are ordinarily expressed in a few words, viz:
"Mutual assistance". Such unions of various trades and
professions were founded in a comparatively short time to
the number of 70 in Canton, over 140 in Hongkong, about 6
30 in Fashan, about 50 at Chiao-chow, and at Kongmun,
Tunking, Swatow and Macao about 70 unions. The total number
of labour organizations in Kwangtung, Hongkong and Macao
is about 400.
A boom for "union-organization" was created and there
arose a strong feeling for the formation of purely labour
organizations, a feeling, which had been artificially
suppressed by the Kwangse reactionaries. Therefore, when
the opportunity came, there was hardly a single profession
which was without an organization of some sort. However,
matters soon became normal and many of the organizations
were voluntarily dissolved, whilst others united themselves
into one body and finally towards the end of 1921 the desire
was manifest for stable organizations to improve their
internal management, organization, committees, etc.
The strike movement: With the growth and formation of
labour organizations the labourers were preparing for an
intensive struggle with the masters. Soon afterwards the
movement started and although at first the labourers acted
individually, their demands soon became uniform and were
more persistent. The demands were mainly for an increase
of wages, improvement of food supplied and of the dwelling
premises, recognition of their unions, through which
workmen were to be employed and dismissed and many other
things.
The second half of the year 1921 was remarkable for the
number of "aggressive" strikes, which involved in Canton
alone over 30 professions affecting over 50,000 persons.
None of the strikes at that period lasted a long time. The
workmen obtained increases of from 20 to 50 percent and
better food and treatment, whilst half of them obtained
reduced working hours. Their main desire was for an increase
of pay and when this question was favourably decided upon,
the labourers were satisfied and ended the strike at that,
deferring their other demands to a more suitable opportu-
nity, that is to say, when their organizations became
stronger.
All strikes passed off in good order as they were guided
by the unions. Accustomed to the old guilds which had
existed for ages the workmen transferred to their unions
their wonderful solidarity and firmness.
The failure of the Cantonese workmen to obtain full
satisfaction in their demands was caused by the efforts at
page_data.zh:
316.

受奴役，拒绝任何工资增加，降低现行工资标准并延长工作时间，确信这样做有助于重建被广西人掠夺的省份。这种情况持续了几个月，直到“节日”精神消退，然后工人们被迫认真思考他们的经济地位。
劳工组织的增长：政治局势的变化使工人能够组建自己的组织，他们开始全力以赴建立工会。某个行业的发起小组召开全体会议，提议建立一个拥有自己会所的统一协会，会员费每月10至20分，设有选举产生的委员会（例如理发师50人，印刷工10人）。协会章程包含几段关于工会成员权利的条款，在某些条款中，社团的目标通常用几个字表达，即：“互助”。这类各种行业和职业的工会在相对较短的时间内成立，广州有70个，香港有140多个，佛山（Fashan）约30个，胶州（Chiao-chow）约50个，江门（Kongmun）、东江（Tunking）、汕头和澳门约有70个工会。广东、香港和澳门的劳工组织总数约为400个。
掀起了一股“工会组织”热潮，产生了建立纯粹劳工组织的强烈愿望，这种愿望此前被广西反动派人为地压制。因此，当机会来临时，几乎没有哪个行业没有某种形式的组织。然而，事情很快恢复正常，许多组织自愿解散，而其他组织则合并为一个整体，最终到1921年底，明显表现出希望建立稳定组织以改善内部管理、组织架构、委员会等的愿望。
罢工运动：随着劳工组织的发展和形成，工人们正准备与雇主进行激烈的斗争。不久之后，运动开始了，虽然起初工人们单独行动，但他们的要求很快变得统一且更加坚持。要求主要是增加工资、改善供应的食物和住宿条件、承认他们的工会（通过工会雇佣和解雇工人）以及许多其他事项。
1921年下半年以“进攻性”罢工的数量为特征，仅在广州就涉及30多个行业，影响超过5万人。当时没有任何一次罢工持续很长时间。工人获得了20%至50%的工资增长以及更好的食物和待遇，其中一半人减少了工作时间。他们的主要愿望是增加薪水，当这个问题得到有利解决时，工人们感到满意并就此结束罢工，将其他要求推迟到更合适的时机，也就是说，当他们的组织变得更强大时。
所有罢工都在有序中进行，因为它们由工会指导。习惯于存在已久的旧行会，工人们将他们出色的团结精神和坚定性转移到了工会中。
广州工人未能完全满足其要求，是由于

page_data.en:
317.

mediation of various officials such as the town Mayor,
Sun-Fo, General Chen, the Governor etc.
Mediation was the favoured method of the Canton Govern-
ment which played upon labour population and the bourgeoisie.
Taking advantage of its popularity the Government played
the part of a fire hose, cleverly extinguishing every strike
at the "most favourable opportunity".
The workmen suffered the most at the hands of the notorious
Town Mayor Sun-Fo. Whenever mediation fell into his hands
the workmen always lost half of their demands. This is the
reason why this "Republican" (who is a pure reactionary)
was very popular amongst the bourgeoisie and the latter
preferred to leave the workmen to him. For instance the
printers( who have a strong organization) won only by half
the battle owing to his pressure. The workmen's child-like
belief that everything was being dictated by special State
considerations, was easily played upon each time.
It is also necessary to note the part played by the
Police in the strikes, the force being under the command
of the Town Mayor. Hardly a strike passed without incidents,
such as throwing persons out of premises and accusations
by authorities of strikers of robbery etc.
Later on when Sun-Yat-sen was at Kweilung, the Government
began to adopt a definite repressive attitude towards the
strikers and a special bureau consisting of the Town Mayor,
General Ngai-Bai-Ping, Frank-Li etc., was formed and entrusted with the task of "twisting" the workmen and suppressing
their movement. General Ngai has openly stated that "these
bad Cantonese workmen must be restrained". The destruction
of unions then followed, but the bureau was unable to carry
out its plans, because its members were themselves expelled
from Canton by General Chen, who, however, completed their
work independently through his own hirelings.
Labour situation in Hongkong: Three years ago when the
Kwangse reactionaries held Kwangtung Province, the Hongkong
neighbours were most "friendly" with them and this friend-
ship was maintained with the Hongkong workmen. (In Hongkong
there are no European workmen except as various kinds of
chiefs, sub-chiefs, and "heads", an element, which, being
a faithful servant to its master oppresses the workmen
worse than any exploiter). The workmen of course had not
much desire to appeal to the reactionary Government for help
against exploitation and the ill-treatment, to which they
were subjected, in Hongkong, because the Kwangse authorities
would not dare even to raise their voice against the British.
The Hongkong labourers had a large number of professional,
socialistic, anarchistic and conspiring organizations, whose
activities were carried on in secret. There were some legal
organizations also, such as the old guilds, but they only
tended to obscure the workmen's minds.
The growth of Hongkong labour unions also coincided with
the occupation of Canton by Sun and Chen. The aptitude for
organization of the Hongkong workmen is considerably higher
than that of the Cantonese and the programmes of their
unions are remarkable for the great thoughtfulness and
clarity. As with Canton the moment the ranks of the labourers
had been formed, strikes followed, the majority of which
ended in victory for the men, culminating in the famous
seamen's strike in which 120,000 men took part. The strike
was of a national character and although the Hongkong autho-
rities mobilized against them all the experience gathered
in the colonial treatment of lsavos viz: money, arms, police,
volunteer detachments, falsehood, provocation, in a word
page_data.zh:
317.

各类官员如市长孙科（Sun-Fo）、陈将军、省长等的调解努力所致。
调解是广州政府 favored 的方法，该政府在劳动人口和资产阶级之间周旋。利用其声望，政府扮演了消防水管的角色，巧妙地在“最有利的时机”扑灭每一次罢工。
工人在臭名昭著的市长孙科手中遭受了最多的损失。每当调解落入他手中时，工人总是失去一半的要求。这就是为什么这位“共和主义者”（他是一个纯粹的反动派）在资产阶级中非常受欢迎，后者更愿意将工人交给他处理。例如，印刷工（拥有强大的组织）由于他的压力只赢得了一半的胜利。工人们天真地相信一切都是由特殊的国家考量所决定的，这种信念每次都容易被利用。
还需要注意警察在罢工中扮演的角色，警力由市长指挥。几乎没有一次罢工不发生事件，如将人赶出场所，以及当局指控罢工者抢劫等。
后来，当孙中山在桂林（Kweilung）时，政府开始对罢工者采取明确的镇压态度，并成立了一个由市长、魏邦平将军（Ngai-Bai-Ping）、李福林（Frank-Li）等人组成的特别局，受托执行“扭转”工人并镇压其运动的任务。魏将军公开表示，“这些不良的广州工人必须受到约束”。随后发生了破坏工会的行为，但该局未能执行其计划，因为其成员自己被陈将军逐出广州，不过，陈将军通过他自己的雇佣人员独立完成了他们的工作。
香港的劳工状况：三年前，当广西反动派控制广东省时，香港邻居与他们最为“友好”，这种友谊也维持着与香港工人的关系。（在香港，除了各种主管、副主管和“头目”外，没有欧洲工人，这一群体作为主人的忠实仆人，比任何剥削者都更严厉地压迫工人）。当然，工人不太渴望向反动政府求助，以对抗他们在香港所遭受的剥削和虐待，因为广西当局甚至不敢在英国人面前发声。
香港劳工拥有大量的职业、社会主义、无政府主义和阴谋组织，其活动秘密进行。也有一些合法组织，如旧行会，但它们往往只会迷惑工人的思想。
香港工会的增长也与孙和陈占领广州相吻合。香港工人的组织能力远高于广州人，其工会纲领以深思熟虑和清晰著称。与广州一样，一旦劳工队伍形成，罢工随之而来，其中大多数以工人的胜利告终，高潮是著名的海员大罢工，有12万人参加。这次罢工具有民族性质，尽管香港当局动员了殖民统治中积累的所有经验来对付他们，即：金钱、武器、警察、志愿队、谎言、挑衅，总之

page_data.en:
318.

all that is known to the reactionary militarists, all methods
failed and the British were compelled to give in and to
send out their Consuls to meet Chinese workmen and to sign
an agreement with them.
Labour situation in Macao: As with Hongkong, the situation
of the labourers in Macao depends entirely upon the state of
political affairs in Canton. During the administration of
the Kwangse authorities, the Macao labourers were in a
worse condition, than those in Hongkong. The Chinese
bourgeoisie of Macao consists mainly in opium den keepers,
brothel keepers and dealers in opium who in co-operation with
a similar class of Portuguese, applied the whip to the local
labourers who were helpless, but the Kwangse authorities
made their position still worse. With the change of authority
in Canton their position in Macao was altered. Unions began
to return speedily one after another and about 30,000 work-
men joined them. Strikes began and resulted in an improve-
ment of the labourers' situation.
As soon, however, as Sun-Yat-sen's position in Canton
became weak, which circumstance was felt at once in Hongkong
and Macao, new repressive measures against workmen were
started. The English being the more experienced people
awaited the final development of affairs in Canton and it
was only after Chen-Chuing-Ming had begun to destroy the
unions in Kwangtung, that the same was started in Hongkong. But
the English soon realized that Chen's position was weak and
having closed several unions ceased to do so. But if the
Hongkong authorities were clever enough to prefer and wait a
few months, knowing beforehand that if their "own" people
come into power in Canton, they will be able to compensate
themselves for losses caused by the strike, the Portuguese
acted differently.
In May 1923 the Portuguese being certain of the imminent
fall of Sun and pressed by the "good" neighbours attacked
not only the "territorial" solicitations of the Chinese, but
decided to end once for all, all labour organizations, by
destroying them completely. The workmen in response to both
the shooting of peaceful citizens and the destruction of
their organizations, went on a general strike, which con-
tinued for more than half a year. The Portuguese could do
nothing with the strikers, though the latter were in great
need and are starving. The Portuguese authorities became
assured that the democrats, whom they disliked, would never
again return to Canton, and had no doubts about their victory.
In reality, however, the contrary was the case and nobody
at present can entertain any doubt of the return of Sun-Yat-
sen to Canton. The Governor of Macao, who was newly appointed,
was forced to change his policy and to give in as soon as
possible, without awaiting Sun's return to Canton, because
it would then have been necessary to comply with the first
demands made by the workmen at the time of Sun's sojourn in
Canton, and not those demands to which the starving ragged
and weakened strikers submitted.
Who has been and is influencing the labour organizations:
There exist several groups who are attempting to influence
in one way or another the labour organizations in Canton,
Hongkong and Macao, and through them the whole of the working
masses. The most important are the group of anarchists, the
Union of Socialistic Youth including active Marxian followers,
the Mutual Aid Society (of which Tsai Yuen-Pei is the Chairman),
the Capitalists and the Old Guilds.
page_data.zh:
318.

反动军阀所知悉的一切，所有方法均告失败，英国人被迫让步，派出领事与中国工人会面并与其签署协议。
澳门劳工状况：与香港一样，澳门工人的状况完全取决于广州的政治局势。在桂系当局统治期间，澳门工人的处境比香港的更糟。澳门的中国资产阶级主要由鸦片馆老板、妓院老板和鸦片商贩组成，他们与类似的葡萄牙人阶层合作，对无助的当地工人施以鞭笞，而桂系当局的统治使他们的处境更加恶化。随着广州政权的更迭，他们在澳门的地位发生了改变。工会开始迅速陆续恢复，约有3万名工人加入。罢工随之爆发，并导致工人状况的改善。
然而，一旦孙中山在广州的地位变得虚弱——这一情况立即在香港和澳门引起反响——针对工人的新镇压措施便开始了。英国人作为经验更为丰富的一方，等待广州事态的最终发展；直到陈炯明开始在广东摧毁工会，香港方面才开始采取同样行动。但英国人很快意识到陈的地位薄弱，在关闭了几个工会后便停止了此举。但是，如果香港当局足够聪明，倾向于等待几个月，因为他们事先知道，如果他们的“自己人”在广州掌权，他们将能够弥补因罢工造成的损失，那么葡萄牙人的做法则不同。
1923年5月，葡萄牙人确信孙中山即将垮台，并在“好”邻居的压力下，不仅攻击中国人的“领土”诉求，还决定一劳永逸地通过彻底摧毁来终结所有劳工组织。作为对和平市民遭枪杀及其组织被毁的回应，工人举行了总罢工，持续了半年多。尽管罢工者极度贫困且处于饥饿状态，葡萄牙人对他们却束手无策。葡萄牙当局确信他们所厌恶的民主派永远不会再回到广州，并对自己的胜利毫不怀疑。然而，实际情况恰恰相反，目前无人能怀疑孙中山将返回广州。新任命的澳门总督被迫改变政策，并尽快让步，无需等待孙中山返回广州，因为若等到那时，就必须满足工人在孙中山驻留广州时期提出的首要要求，而不是那些饥寒交迫、衣衫褴褛且虚弱的罢工者所屈服的要求。
谁在影响以及正在影响劳工组织：有几个团体正试图以某种方式影响广州、香港和澳门的劳工组织，并通过它们影响整个劳动群众。其中最重要的是无政府主义者团体、包含活跃马克思主义追随者的社会主义青年联盟、互助社（蔡元培任主席）、资本家以及旧行会。

319.

Each of these groups had several tens of unions and
some of them with the change of political situation, began
to impose their power on labour organizations, but none of
the groups were able to boast of complete influence over
the labour masses, Sun-Yat-sen alone having this undisputable
influence over the entire labour population. The policy of
playing between bourgeoisie and workmen was successful and
he managed to inspire the labourers with the necessity of
supporting the Government. Thus, as long as the war with the
North continued, every time that he appealed to them directly
or through his representatives the labourers never refused
to help. But everything that was done by Sun-Yat-sen to
strengthen his influence over the labour masses, was des-
troyed by members of the Kuomintang party. Such persons as
Sun-Fo, Ngai-Bai-Ping, Frank-Li, Wu-Fei (Chief of Police)
and even Wu-Ting-Fang during the short period before Sun's
defeat assured the workmen, that the Kuomintang party was
the enemy of labour in order to make use of them to
strengthen their own authority and then to oppress the work-
men. The Kuomintang party which had no large influence
over the labour masses, through its repressions a month
previous to its expulsion by Chen, began to create discontent
amongst the labourers and the struggle which later took place
between Chen and the workmen would have occurred between
the labourers and the Kuomintang. Fortunately, however, the
Kuomintang were expelled and thus maintained their influence
over a large portion of the workmen so that a movement
started by the Union of Socialistic Youth for the unification
of all labour unions into one single Federation during Chen's
period was discontinued on account of the return of the
Kuomintang. The Old Federation of (Wan-Wung-tin) which has
been dissolved by the workers themselves, was revived and
its existence sanctioned by the Governor, whilst the new
Federation, established by Chen and his followers was ordered
to close. The New Federation being more useful for the
workmen, did not, however, entirely disappear because of the
Kuomintang pressure, but this struggle will cause a new
split amongst the labourers for some time to come.
The Kuomintang party dominated the workmen in the South,
but now it may be said with certainty that as a whole, their
influence has ceased and only Sun-Yat-sen's popularity still
survives amongst the workmen, which will be made use of by
the Kuomintang in their own interests.
The Mutual Aid Society: One of the prominent Canton
organizations which had great influence over the workmen,
was the Mutual Aid Society, which, after being suppressed
by Chen-Chming Ming was revived and began its activities
anew. The Chief of this organization named Tse-Yun-Pa, who
is the Chairman of the Society, is also a Member of the Old
Parliament, a Participant in the First Chinese Revolution,
the Editor of two newspapers and one of the prominent mem-
bers of Kuomintang party. He considers himself a "pure"
follower of Marx, a socialist and at the same time acts in
close connection with Doctor Colbert, who has stated that he
is an anarchist. The Mutual Aid Society was founded in 1920
and has 11 branches with about 50,000 members. Members of
the Society consist of labourers, intelligentsia, soldiers,
officers, clerks, students, Government officials etc.
Fourteen unions of labour organizations were members of
the Society and about 30 gave regular support to it. The
Mutual Aid Society directed the workmen's political life
and did not interfere in economic questions. One of its

这些团体各自拥有数十个工会，其中一些随着政治局势的变化，开始将其权力强加于劳工组织之上，但没有一个团体能够夸口对劳动群众拥有完全的影响力，只有孙中山对整个劳动人口拥有这种无可争议的影响。他在资产阶级和工人之间周旋的政策取得了成功，他设法让工人们认识到支持政府的必要性。因此，只要北伐战争持续，每当他直接或通过代表向工人们呼吁时，工人们从未拒绝提供帮助。但是，孙中山为加强对劳动群众影响力所做的一切努力，都被国民党成员所破坏。诸如孙科、魏邦平、李福林、吴飞（警察局长）甚至伍廷芳等人，在孙中山失败前的短暂时期内，向工人保证国民党是劳工的敌人，目的是利用工人来加强他们自己的权威，随后便压迫工人。国民党在劳动群众中本无巨大影响力，但在被陈炯明驱逐前一个月，其镇压行为开始在工人中制造不满，后来陈炯明与工人之间发生的斗争，原本会是工人与国民党之间的斗争。然而幸运的是，国民党被驱逐，从而保持了其对大部分工人的影响力，以至于社会主义青年联盟在陈炯明时期发起的将所有工会统一为一个联合会的运动，因国民党的回归而中止。由工人自行解散的旧联合会（万福堂）得以复兴，其存在得到总督的认可，而由陈炯明及其追随者建立的新联合会则被勒令关闭。新联合会对工人更为有利，但由于国民党的压力并未完全消失，这场斗争将在未来一段时间内导致工人阶层新的分裂。
国民党曾主导南方的工人，但现在可以肯定地说，总体而言，其影响力已经终结，只有孙中山的声望仍在工人中存续，国民党将为了自身利益加以利用。
互助社：广州的一个著名组织，对工人有很大影响，即互助社，该社在被陈炯明镇压后得以复兴并重新开始活动。该组织负责人谢英伯（音译），身为社主席，同时也是旧国会成员、第一次中国革命的参与者、两家报纸的编辑以及国民党的 prominent 成员之一。他自视为马克思的“纯粹”追随者、社会主义者，同时与科尔伯特博士（Dr. Colbert）保持密切联系，后者声称自己是无政府主义者。互助社成立于1920年，拥有11个分支，会员约5万人。社员包括工人、知识分子、士兵、军官、职员、学生、政府官员等。
十四个劳工组织的工会是该社成员，另有约三十个定期给予支持。互助社指导工人的政治生活，不干涉经济问题。其

page_data.en:
319.

principal aims was the "future" control of the Government
by workmen, the abolition of the capitalistic system and
the realization of International Social Revolution.
Whilst making known their organization by fine expres-
sions and striking mottoes, the Mutual Aid Society in
reality was the faithful agent of the Kuomintang and it
purposed to submit the labour masses in obedience to
Sun-Yat-Sen's Government. Every union, which refused to
follow the Kuomintang party's instructions was cruelly,
persecuted and was not given support during a strike.
When Sun-Yat-sen proceeded to the North with his troops
and occupied towns in the Kiangse Province, the Mutual
Aid Society was engaged in Canton in developing the
patriotic feelings of the labour masses and advocated
support of the Government. The matter went so far that
Tse-Yun-Pa himself, as head of the Society, went about the
town accompanied by members of his committee and distri-
buted hand-bills from motor cars announcing the occupation
of towns. This information subsequently turned out to be
false.
With the change in the political situation the heads of
the Society including Tse-Yun-Pa upon returning to Canton
commenced their activities together with Dr. Colbert.
which were very slow until the Kuomintang position in
Canton became once more secure.
If one remembers the activities of the Mutual Aid
Society at the time of the Conference held by the Chinese
labour organizations in Canton, when the Kuomintang
party was defeated at the Conference, and made attempts
to stop the Conference by sending representatives from
20 non-existing organizations to attend it, it will
become clear that the New Federation will meet opposition
on the part of the Mutual Aid Society and will be destroyed
by the latter. There is information that the struggle
has already begun.
The group of Old Guilds: During the Manchu Dynasty
one of the brave captains of the seventh Canton district
named Lam-Yun-pan received instructions from the authori-
ties to interfere in conflicts between labourers and
merchants. The Captain organized a so-called Industrial
union which like the angel guardian reconciled the sheep
and the wolves. Later on the Union was called the Federa-
tion of Unions. Only recently the Union had a membership
of 15,000 members, but with the falling off of the Old
Guilds, the influence of this organization began to wane,
but during the regime of the Kwangse reactionaries it
exercised great influence. Such organizations as the
labour union of silk manufacture, the union of blackwood
furniture makers' are still members of that institution.
But the labour organizations are gradually quitting it
to join pure labour institutions and none of the new
unions have joined it. Formerly this organization played
a leading role, now it has come to naught.
Anarchists: The Canton or, in other words, the Southern
group of anarchists has been in existence a long time. It
has as members the league of advanced professions and a
very limited number of workmen. After working together
for so long a time, the members of this group are very
friendly towards one another. The majority of its members,
being workers of the first revolution, the group of
anarchists took deep root with labour masses and had its
members a better understanding of their own ideas, their
influence would have been extremely strong and dangerous.
page_data.zh:
319.

主要目标之一是工人对政府的“未来”控制，废除资本主义制度，以及实现国际社会主义革命。
互助社虽然用华丽的辞藻和醒目的口号宣传其组织，但实际上它是国民党的忠实代理人，旨在使劳动群众服从于孙中山政府。任何拒绝遵循国民党指示的工会都会受到残酷迫害，并且在罢工期间得不到支持。
当孙中山率军北上并占领江西省城镇时，互助社在广州致力于激发劳动群众的爱国情感，并倡导支持政府。事态发展到如此地步，以至于该社社长谢英伯亲自带领委员会成员在城中穿梭，乘坐汽车散发传单，宣布城镇被占领的消息。后来证实这些信息是虚假的。
随着政治局势的变化，包括谢英伯在内的社团领导人在返回广州后，开始与科尔伯特博士一起开展活动，但在国民党在广州的地位再次稳固之前，这些活动进展非常缓慢。
如果人们记得在中国劳工组织于广州召开会议期间互助社的活动，当时国民党在会议上失利，并试图通过派遣来自20个不存在组织的代表参加会议来阻止会议，那么就会清楚，新联合会将面临互助社的反对，并会被后者摧毁。有消息称，斗争已经开始。
旧行会团体：在清朝时期，广州第七区的一位名叫林云攀（音译）的勇敢队长接到当局指令，介入工人与商人之间的冲突。这位队长组织了一个所谓的工业联合会，它像守护天使一样调和绵羊与狼。后来该联合会被称为工会联合会。就在最近，该联合会拥有15,000名会员，但随着旧行会的衰落，该组织的影响力开始减弱，不过在桂系反动派统治期间，它曾发挥巨大影响。诸如丝绸制造业工会、黑木家具制造工会等组织仍是该机构的成员。但劳工组织正逐渐退出，加入纯粹的劳工机构，没有任何新工会加入其中。以前该组织扮演领导角色，如今已化为乌有。
无政府主义者：广州或称南方无政府主义者团体已存在很长时间。其成员包括高级职业联盟和极少数工人。经过如此长时间的合作，该团体成员之间关系非常友好。其多数成员是第一次革命的工人，如果无政府主义者团体在劳动群众中扎根更深，且其成员对自己的理念有更好的理解，其影响力将会极其强大且危险。

321.

In Canton the strong unions such as the union of merchants,
the union of masons, shoe makers, barbers, restaurant
employees etc., were organized by anarchists. The league
of unions which included over 75 unions in Canton, Hongkong,
Swatow and Chiaochow was also organized by them.
The Old Guilds suffered to the advantage of the League of
unions.
Some of the members of the anarchist group were active in
the Fukien Province with General Chen-Chuing-ling and this
still more increased their popularity amongst the workmen.
Since the return of Sun to Canton the activities of the
anarchists have become more energetic, but the first blow
was dealt them by General Chen-Chuing-ling himself, who
refused to assist them with funds. Other sources that used
to support the group also ceased their help. General Chen-
Chuing-ling, knowing everyone of the chief anarchists, in
order to stop their activities which disturbed them, sugges-
ted that they should go to Europe to study, which offer was
accepted with pleasure and a group of anarchists left Canton.
Those remaining, continued their work amongst the labourers,
but defeated on all sides, they could not be very active so
that gradually they lost their influence over the union
after another. Their only hope lay in the repressions com-
menced against the workmen by the Kuomintang party, but
General Chen expelled the latter and the anarchists fled
immediately deserting the unions in their charge. When
they returned, they found many unions refusing to co-operate
with them and would not admit them into their labour
organizations. Some of the unions fell under the influence
of the Union of Socialistic Youth, whilst another portion
joined the Old Federation. In general it may be definitely
stated that the influence of the anarchists over the
Canton unions has almost ceased, but the anarchist leaders
have ground in asserting that the labourers will suffer
great repression at the hands of the Kuomintang and thus
they hope to regain their power over the old unions.
Union of Socialistic Youth: Great moral influence was
exercised over labourers by the group of Marxian followers
together with the newspaper "Social", which has now been
suspended. Surrounding itself with the best educated people,
the group carried out a serious propaganda amongst the work-
men, yet it was unable to unite the labour unions or to
concentrate their forces, only a few unions were under its
direct influence. The programme planned by the group is,
however, successfully being carried out by the Union of
Socialistic Youth with many Marxian followers as members.
The activities of the union of Socialistic Youth greatly
developed amongst workmen at the time when Chen-Chuing-ling
was in power, for the labour masses began to realize the
futility of relying upon any of the governors to protect
their interests, as had been promised so often.
The result of the activity of the Union of Socialistic
Union was the formation of a New Labour Federation which at
present includes over 200 united unions. In reality this
unification was effected by the workmen themselves, with
the Union helping them in various ways. The Old Federation,
being out of place was dissolved by the workmen. Thus after
many hard efforts the Canton labourers had their own way and
began to look with more courage on their future. They then
took steps to unify the unions in other Provinces. But a
new development in the political situation viz: Chen's expul-
sion and Sun's return, altered matters. With the return of
the Kuomintang to Canton, the national militaristic party,

在广州，诸如商人公会、泥瓦匠公会、鞋匠公会、理发师公会、餐馆雇员公会等强有力的工会，均由无政府主义者组织。涵盖广州、香港、汕头及潮州（Chiaochow）等地七十余个工会的工会联合会，亦由他们组建。旧式行会因此受损，而工会联合会则从中获益。

无政府主义团体的部分成员在福建省与陈炯明将军（General Chen-Chuing-ling）一道活动，这进一步增加了他们在工人中的声望。自孙中山返回广州以来，无政府主义者的活动变得更为活跃，但给予他们首次打击的正是陈炯明将军本人，他拒绝向他们提供资金援助。其他以往支持该团体的来源也停止了帮助。陈炯明将军认识每一位主要的无政府主义者，为了制止他们扰乱局势的活动，建议他们前往欧洲留学，这一提议被欣然接受，随后一群无政府主义者离开了广州。

留下的人继续在劳工中开展工作，但由于处处受挫，他们无法保持高度的活跃度，因而逐渐失去了对一个又一个工会的影响力。他们唯一的希望寄托于国民党对工人开始的镇压，但陈将军驱逐了国民党人，无政府主义者随即逃离，抛弃了他们所负责的工会。当他们返回时，发现许多工会拒绝与他们合作，并不允许他们加入各自的劳工组织。部分工会落入社会主义青年团（Union of Socialistic Youth）的影响之下，而另一部分则加入了旧联合会。总体而言，可以明确断言，无政府主义者对广州工会的影响已几乎消失，但无政府主义领袖们仍有理由声称，工人将遭受国民党的严厉镇压，从而希望借此重新获得对旧工会的控制权。

社会主义青年团：马克思主义追随者群体连同现已停刊的《社会》（Social）报，对工人施加了巨大的道德影响。该团体聚集了受教育程度最高的人士，在工人中开展了严肃的宣传工作，然而它未能联合各工会或集中其力量，仅有少数工会受其直接影响。不过，该团体计划的纲领正由社会主义青年团成功实施，许多马克思主义追随者均为其成员。

在陈炯明掌权期间，社会主义青年团在工人中的活动大为发展，因为劳动大众开始意识到，依赖任何统治者来保护其利益——正如以往多次承诺的那样——是徒劳的。

社会主义青年团活动的结果是成立了新劳工联合会，目前该联合会包含两百多个联合工会。实际上，这种统一是由工人自身完成的，工会联合会在各方面为他们提供了帮助。旧联合会因不合时宜而被工人解散。因此，经过诸多艰苦努力，广州劳工得以按自己的意愿行事，并开始以更勇敢的态度展望他们的未来。随后，他们采取措施统一其他省份的工会。但政治局势的新发展，即陈炯明被驱逐和孙中山回归，改变了局面。随着国民党这一全国性军事政党回归广州，
